comment_event_check.name: comment_event_check
comment_event_check.value:
(
				"comment"."kind" = 'comment'
				and "comment"."event_type" is null
				and "comment"."event_from" is null
				and "comment"."event_to" is null
				and "comment"."event_note" is null
			) or (
				"comment"."kind" = 'event'
				and "comment"."event_type" in (
					'status', 'start_date', 'due_date', 'assignee_added',
					'assignee_removed', 'estimate_minutes', 'milestone_locked',
					'milestone_unlocked', 'change_request_created',
					'change_request_accepted', 'change_request_declined',
					'change_request_moved', 'change_request_withdrawn'
				)
			)

milestone_dates_check.name: milestone_dates_check
milestone_dates_check.value: "milestone"."start_date" is null or "milestone"."due_date" is null or "milestone"."start_date" <= "milestone"."due_date"

milestone_scope_entry_round_check.name: milestone_scope_entry_round_check
milestone_scope_entry_round_check.value: ("milestone_scope_entry"."kind" = 'change' and "milestone_scope_entry"."round" is null) or ("milestone_scope_entry"."kind" in ('test', 'review') and "milestone_scope_entry"."round" is not null and "milestone_scope_entry"."round" > 0)

milestone_scope_entry_period_check.name: milestone_scope_entry_period_check
milestone_scope_entry_period_check.value: ("milestone_scope_entry"."kind" = 'change' and "milestone_scope_entry"."status_period_id" is null) or ("milestone_scope_entry"."kind" in ('test', 'review') and "milestone_scope_entry"."status_period_id" is not null)

notification_actor_delete.name: notification_actor_delete
notification_actor_delete.using: "notification"."organization_id" = current_setting('app.current_org_id', true) and actor_user_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id', true)
